sections.content: To say something is inside a place, add -ban (back vowel words) or -ben (front vowel words) directly to the noun. Hungarian has no separate word for 'in.'
sections.title: Saying where something is

items.english: The phone is in the kitchen.

sections.content: Vowel harmony again: konyha has back vowels so it takes -ban (konyhában), while könyv has a front vowel so it takes -ben (könyvben).
